<threat_model>
## Trust Boundaries
| Boundary | Description |
|---|---|
| member→export POST | Month, shed, counts and JSON are untrusted. |
| list→database | Saved ids describe work but carry no authority. |
## STRIDE Threat Register
| Threat ID | Category | Component | Severity | Disposition | Mitigation Plan |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| T-04-04 | Elevation of Privilege | export creation | high | mitigate | Require lend on the source shed and choose the staging place on the server. |
| T-04-05 | Tampering | saved loan ids | high | mitigate | Shed scoping plus an independent uniqueness check. |
| T-04-06 | Denial of Service | month walk | high | mitigate | Bound payloads, rows and range length, and enforce a named deadline and cap before the transaction. |
</threat_model>
